Duties also include screening telephone calls for the Member and staff, greeting and screening visitors, assisting persons with appointments, responding to constituent requests for flags, tours and other information, maintaining handout literature, signing for deliveries, maintaining the office answering machine or voice mail, directing requests for assistance to appropriate staff, recording visitor opinions, logging in mail, performing general typing and administrative assignments, sending and receiving facsimile materials, and performing other administrative and legislative duties as assigned.
